leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom function that replicates the core behavior of the native Array.map method.
Implement the custom map function to accept a callback as an argument.
Initialize a new array within the function to store transformed elements.
Manipulate array indices and elements by applying the callback to each item.
Control the execution flow to iterate through the original array without using built-in iteration methods.
Integrate the custom map function into a sample script to transform data.
Configure the callback to receive current element, index, and original array parameters.
